text:
Anika: quick sync — we need a final checklist for the marketplace launch week. coordinating press, blog, and partner pages. who’s got the latest asset list?
Tom: I have a draft of the press release and blog outline. waiting on partner logos + legal signoff.
Kelsey: design signoff for landing page hero is done, but need final logo variants (SVG + white/colored).
Luis: product note — marketplace entitlements require a config file per provider (gcp/azure/aws). Sam can confirm service account step.
Sam: confirmed. I pushed a test script to the repo: `scripts/marketplace/test-entitlement.sh` — it creates the service account and runs validation.
Priya: legal needs 48h for partner trademark + co-brand clauses. send the logos and intended usage screenshots.
Anika: action items: 1) logos to Priya by Tue EOD, 2) press embargo time (TBD), 3) deployment test on staging Wed morning.
Tom: suggested embargo: Thu 09:00 PT. that avoids EMEA late hours. thoughts?
Luis: Thu 09:00 PT works from infra side. we can open canary listings at 06:00 PT for internal verification.
Kelsey: will schedule a UI freeze Tue 23:59 PT. after that only critical fixes.
Sam: canary listing steps: `./deploy canary --provider=gcp --version=1.2.0` then smoke test. should take ~30m.
Anika: partners to notify: CloudVendor, SI-IntegrateCo, HW-PartnerX. CloudVendor requested co-announcement quote by Wed noon.
Tom: I'll draft the quote and share in #drafts-marketing. can someone from product add a short usage stat? e.g., latency improvement numbers for marketplace spin-up.
Luis: grabbing numbers now. will drop 99th pct and avg token/sec in #drafts-marketing in 1hr.
Priya: reminder — any partner mentions that imply SLA commitments need legal approval. disclaimers ok, but avoid firm uptime promises.
Kelsey: design note — partner spotlights on the landing page should be 300x100 logos. please provide PNG and SVG.
Anika: checkpoint: do we have a press contact at CloudVendor? need name + email for embargo distribution.
Tom: CloudVendor PR is Meera Shah — meera.shah@cloudvendor.com. added to the doc.
Sam: FYI running the entitlement test on staging now. posting logs if anything fails.
launch-bot: deploy-check — canary create started by Sam at 1790124000. status: in-progress.
Sam: smoke test green. `OK` on gcp canary at 1790124105.
Anika: great — we can do internal preview Thur 07:00 PT. invite list: sales, solutions, partner reps, marketing ops.
Tom: blog plan: 900-1200 words, hero quote from CloudVendor + one customer quote. draft due Wed 14:00 PT.
Kelsey: I’ll create the landing page template and a staging URL by Wed morning.
Priya: I've approved the co-brand clause for CloudVendor; SI-IntegrateCo needs a minor amendment. ping me when their legal sends the doc.
Luis: quick technical blocker: HW-PartnerX needs a special image for the marketplace tile (16:9) and a short integration blurb. can HW-PartnerX product team provide by Tue 12:00?
Anika: I'll chase them now. @Tom can you coordinate the co-marketing calendar with their comms lead?
Tom: on it. putting a calendar invite for Mon 10:00 PT with HW-PartnerX comms.
Sam: note for oncall — if listing fails during rollout, fallback policy is to route traffic to hosted-api for matched accounts. I’ll draft the runbook.
Anika: runbook link pls when ready. also need a single source-of-truth doc: `docs/marketplace/launch-orbit-sheet` — I'll update with final owners + times.
Tom: sharing draft press release link: https://hackmd.io/r/redwood-marketplace-press-draft — comments open.
Kelsey: uploaded hero comps to Figma. link in the orbit sheet.
Priya: please add the embargo timestamp into the orbit sheet once decided — legal needs to note distribution list.
Anika: final check — are there any outstanding content translations for EU locales? we should decide if we translate the blog pre-launch or post-launch.
Tom: propose post-launch ASAP. too tight to get accurate translations before Thu.
Luis: agree — keep launch mono-lingual, then internationalize in sprint after.
Anika: OK. summary of next steps (short):
- Logos & trademark docs -> Priya by Tue EOD (owner: partners)
- Product usage stats -> Luis by Tue 11:00
- Blog draft -> Tom by Wed 14:00
- Landing page comps + staging URL -> Kelsey by Wed morning
- Canary listing + smoke test -> Sam Wed 06:00 PT
- Legal approval for SI-IntegrateCo -> Priya pending their doc
- Press embargo decision -> Tom to finalize with CloudVendor (target Thu 09:00 PT)
- Runbook -> Sam by Wed EOD
Anika: tagging owners in the orbit sheet now. please ack with :thumbsup: and update if timelines slip.
Kelsey: :thumbsup:
Tom: :thumbsup: added calendar invite for PR distribution test Wed 16:00 PT
Luis: :thumbsup: I’ve posted the latency numbers in #drafts-marketing
Sam: :thumbsup: runbook draft up at `docs/ops/marketplace-rollout-runbook.md`
Priya: :thumbsup: will confirm SI clause once received
Anika: thanks team — will run a final pre-launch check-in Wed 18:00 PT.
Tom: see you then.
